en: A black-and-white vintage street scene showing a bustling European city, with ornate multi-story buildings on the left and a prominent Baroque-style church with a tall spire and cross on the right. People in early 20th-century clothing are walking and horse-drawn carriages are present. Signs on the storefronts include 'Stein' and 'KOSZEC H.' This appears to be an urban boulevard.
